units.title: Wire pre-commit hook to block z.any() reintroduction
units.notes:
Built .claude/hooks/zany-reintroduction-block.mjs (~170 lines) PreToolUse(Write|Edit) hook that gates z.any() reintroduction in **/schemas/*.ts files. Pure-function exports for tests: isSchemaFile (cross-platform path with backslash normalisation, case-insensitive .ts, rejects nested-schemas-subdir paths and non-.ts), countZAnyCalls (regex \bz\.any\s*\( — whitespace-tolerant, not fooled by z.anyof or unprefixed Math.any or comments), decideBlock (Write blocks ANY z.any() in newContent for schemas; Edit blocks NET-POSITIVE addition only — refactor and removal pass through), parsePreToolUsePayload (extracts tool_name + tool_input.file_path + content/new_string/old_string from Claude Code hook stdin shape; null on malformed JSON). I/O layer reads stdin with 250ms timeout safety, emits {continue:false, decision:'block', reason, hookSpecificOutput:{permissionDecision:'deny',...}} when blocking; defaults to {continue:true} on any error so a hook crash never blocks legitimate work. Wired into iooms0/.claude/settings.json PreToolUse with matcher '^(Write|Edit)$' (timeout 1500ms, continueOnError:true). Tests: ZanyReintroductionBlock.test.ts 31/31 green covering 7 isSchemaFile cases (matches/backslash-norm/case/non-schema/nested-subdir-rejection/non-ts/null-empty), 6 countZAnyCalls cases (simple/whitespace/multi-occurrence/z.anyof-not-matched/comments-not-matched/null-empty), 5 Write-tool decideBlock cases (block-with-zany/multi-zany-count/clean-pass/non-schema-pass/non-Write-Edit-pass), 6 Edit-tool decideBlock cases (net-positive-block/net-zero-pass/net-negative-pass/missing-old-treats-as-zero/multi-add-counted), 3 defensive-path cases (null/non-string/non-schema-with-Write), 5 parsePreToolUsePayload cases (Write payload, Edit payload, malformed JSON, missing tool_name, missing fields default to empty). Two real bugs fixed during build: (a) hook file shebang `#!/usr/bin/env node` broke Vite SSR import (same fix as scripts/docker-audit.mjs etc); (b) JSDoc comment containing literal '*/schemas/*.ts' closed the comment block prematurely — replaced with escaped form '**\/schemas\/*.ts'.

phases.rationale: User question: vision model for PDF extraction. Llama 3.2 Vision 11B is multimodal. Current /pdf-learn skill does text-only extraction; misses image content (engineering diagrams, scanned drawings, manufacturer catalog images).

units.title: Build VisionExtractionEngine — wraps llama3.2-vision for image+text understanding
units.rollback: remove engine; PDF extraction falls back to text-only path
units.notes: Built VisionExtractionEngine.ts (~210 lines) — thin wrapper around Ollama llama3.2-vision:11b for image+text + qwen2.5-coder:7b text fallback. Pure-function exports for tests: normalizeInput (extension-based kind detection: image|pdf|text|unknown with case-insensitive PNG/JPG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/WEBP, PDF, TXT/MD/CSV/JSON/YAML/YML; trims, null-safe), selectModel (image+pdf→vision, text→qwen, unknown→fallback to qwen; modelOverride wins, forceText collapses to qwen, override beats forceText), encodeImageToBase64 (Uint8Array via Buffer.toString('base64'), strips data: URL prefix from string input, empty-safe), buildOllamaRequest (correct {model,prompt,stream:false} shape; images[] only when imageB64 truthy), parseOllamaResponse (Ollama {response:string} → {text,ok,error?} envelope; handles missing field, non-string response, null/non-object input, preserves empty-string response). I/O layer .extract() returns structured envelope with {ok, text?, model, kind, durationMs, error?, ts}; refuses PDF input with hint about P13-U03 batch-processor (which renders to image first); refuses unsupported extensions; gracefully fails on Ollama unreachable / non-200 / malformed JSON. Wired prism_dev:vision_extract in devDispatcher.ts (validates required prompt + passes through optional path/kind/model/host). Tests: VisionExtraction.test.ts 36/36 green covering 8 normalizeInput cases, 7 selectModel cases (incl. modelOverride+forceText interaction), 5 encodeImageToBase64 cases (Uint8Array, data: URL strip, identity, empty, 'Hello'→'SGVsbG8='), 4 buildOllamaRequest cases, 5 parseOllamaResponse cases (well-formed, missing field, non-string, null, empty-string response), 6 .extract() error envelopes (no live Ollama needed: missing prompt, non-string prompt, invalid path early-exit, unsupported extension, PDF rejection with P13-U03 hint, durationMs+ts always present), 1 singleton sanity. Two real bugs fixed during build: (a) initial test had wrong base64 expected for 4-byte JPEG header (correct is /9j/4A==, not /9j/4OA= which would be 5 bytes); (b) engine's `else if (req.path)` skipped empty-string path so it fell through to text-only Ollama call instead of erroring early — fixed by checking `typeof req.path === "string"` so any provided path string is validated.
